description: Magnifies a single analysis window: synthesizes a steady sound of duration dur from the analysis data at the one window nearest time. The output duration is set entirely by dur, independent of the input's length (verified: identical output from a 2 s and a 3 s input sharing the same window content). Formerly named SPECWEXP. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Draw a single moment of timbral interest out into a steady, examinable sound — a spectral magnifying glass. Listen through the source for windows worth dwelling on: a wide spread of frequencies and rapidly changing timbral content are the two things to hunt for; the resulting drone can then stand alone or become source material for further processing. Compare spec grab, which extracts the window as a single-window .ana for freezing or morph work — magnify instead renders the moment at a chosen duration in one step. The output is a static spectrum, so expect a synthetic, organ-pipe steadiness; the resynthesized sound will need topping and tailing (the attack and ending are abrupt-cut analysis data, not shaped).

time.description: Time in the input file of the window to magnify. CDP enforces 0 to the input's analysed duration (refusal probed: 'out of range (0.000000 to 2.025941)' on a 2 s input). Scalar only — a breakpoint file is refused ('brkpnt_files not permitted').

dur.description: Required output duration; directly sets the output length (verified within 0.2% at 1.0, 2.0 and 2.5 s, and at 40 s). The banner says it MUST exceed the analysis window length, but CDP does not enforce this — see known_issues. Scalar only — a breakpoint file is refused.

examples.description: Magnify the window at 0.5 s into a 6-second steady sound.
examples.expected_use: Turn a fleeting timbral moment into a drone long enough to hear inside.

known_issues: Banner requirement unenforced (divergence): dur 'MUST BE > the analysis window length', but a probe at dur=0.01 exits 0 and silently produces a .ana that resynthesizes to ZERO frames of audio. Keep dur comfortably above the window length (> ~0.03 s at default analysis settings) or the output is empty with no error raised.
afta8's max of 30 s and SoundThread's 480 s ceiling are UI ranges only — a 40 s output was verified clean (39.9964 s measured).
Both parameters are scalar-only; raw refusals: 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 1 [b_time.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' / 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 2 [b_dur.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'
